alpha_ranking_policy.group_definition: deterministic equal-count rank quartiles Q1..Q4; earlier quartile receives remainder only if exact equal split impossible
alpha_ranking_policy.population: Candidate-E ENTER events only, pooled H2+H3

event_selection_policy.abstain_rule: no qualifying Candidate-E opportunity at any anchor
event_selection_policy.alpha_value_for_entry: conditional_alpha on the selected Candidate-E opportunity row
event_selection_policy.anchor_rule: first anchor containing at least one Candidate-E qualifying opportunity

conditions: pooled Q4 base P&L per entry > pooled Q1
pooled Q4 +1c P&L per entry > pooled Q1
pooled upper-half base P&L per entry > pooled lower-half
pooled upper-half +1c P&L per entry > pooled lower-half
H2 Q4 base P&L per entry > H2 Q1
H3 Q4 base P&L per entry > H3 Q1
exploratory_triage_rule.meaning: Research triage only. PROMISING does not pass a trading strategy and cannot authorize threshold selection or execution.

forbidden_after_run: choose an alpha threshold from H2/H3 P&L and call it validated
inspect C1/C2/C3 or protected reserve under this diagnostic
next_step_if_no_clear_signal: Close conditional-alpha-as-entry-filter on H evidence and move to a different simple entry-filter hypothesis.
next_step_if_promising: Design and predeclare a separately versioned Candidate-E entry-filter strategy and an evidence plan before any additional validation evidence is opened.
purpose: Exploratory H2/H3 economics diagnostic asking whether the already-frozen conditional-alpha v2 score contains useful entry-ranking information when Candidate E remains the valuation probability.

baseline: base hold-to-settlement P&L per entry pooled/H2/H3
continuous: Spearman rank correlation: alpha vs base realized P&L
contrasts: Q4 minus Q1 base P&L per entry
Q4 minus Q1 +1c P&L per entry
upper-half Q3+Q4 minus lower-half Q1+Q2 base P&L per entry
upper-half Q3+Q4 minus lower-half Q1+Q2 +1c P&L per entry

valuation_policy.fee_rule: reuse frozen standard_entry_fee from conditional-alpha v1
